summary: Moving from version 1 is now done safely in the web app, with a preview before anything changes.

new.title: Import v1 data in the web app
new.text: SuperAdmins can upload version 1 files on the new Import v1 page. You first see what would be added or changed, then import; rules made in the app are never touched.

new.title: No special database rights needed
new.text: Importing version 1 data no longer needs database rights. Every import is recorded in the change history and Audit.

new.title: Simpler, consistent install options
new.text: The install now names your Invardia Support app and its starting support level the same way as other Invardia products, and can resume an interrupted install.
